additional_obligations: A predication witness belongs to one selected local claim and its own subject/predicate readings and reference.
Equivalent semantic readings may use different local proof identities.
Relative or embedded belief predicates cannot license an unrelated outer assertion.
Missing, swapped, altered, or stale evidence cannot silently yield a supported constrained answer.
Nominal derivation features survive both lexical-reading producers and reach answer explanation.
Description-based nominal alternatives retain source and occurrence bindings, uncertainty, conflict, and the missing lexical-sense bridge.
Withdrawing or replacing an explicit description rejects its old report and answer on fresh replay.
Generated shape alone supplies neither nominal meaning nor external truth.
